rubric_items.reason: All 15 known REQs are traced: S-1 REQ-1..4,11; S-2 REQ-5; S-3 REQ-6..10; S-4 REQ-12,13; S-5 REQ-14,15. None are assumed or unknown.
Each story now delivers one outcome. Personal-data checks moved from S-4 to S-5 (prior F-4 resolved).

S-2 AC2/AC3 test the first local day on both sides of midnight, S-3 AC1 tests the list across the local boundary, S-4 AC4 covers doctor tiles. S-2 AC1 has a relative Then, and the existing tiles' links are not checked.
Instants are derived inline with the UTC+05:30 offset; the 12 Nov and 20 Oct period starts follow from the glossary rule; 21 patients vs 20 per page comes from REQ-8.
Terms match the glossary and intent; the body mirrors the front matter; titles are user-facing.

findings.text: S-2 AC1 has a relative Then ('updates the same way the Completed and Cancelled tiles do') and no observable expected value. AC2 to AC4 already test the switch concretely, so AC1 is weak or redundant.

cites.quote: then the New patients count updates the same way the Completed and Cancelled tiles do

findings.suggested_fix: State a concrete Then for S-2 AC1, for example the count changes from the Today value to the Last 7 days value, or drop it in favour of AC2.

findings.text: The glossary says each dashboard tile links to the list it counts. S-4 checks that existing tiles show the same counts, but no AC checks that their links are unchanged (REQ-13).

cites.quote: tiles that count patients, doctors and appointments, each linking to the list it
then the tiles that count doctors show the same counts as before this change.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-4 AC: selecting an existing tile (for example Total patients) opens the same list as before this change.

cites.quote: The dashboard has a tile labelled `New patients`.
The tile shows the number of patients whose `created_at` falls in the selected period.
The period's days are whole hospital-local days in `Asia/Kolkata`.
A run of whole hospital-local days ending today: Today, Last 7 days or Last 30 days.
The list opened from the tile shows all statuses (`All statuses from tile`)
The filtered patient list stays at `20 per page`.
When the list is opened from the tile, a search already typed on the list is `cleared`.
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.
tiles that count patients, doctors and appointments
